projects.title: AI-Based Career Recommendation System
projects.subtitle: Intelligent Guidance & Resume Engineering Platform
projects.shortDescription: A comprehensive career platform integrating assessment-driven ML recommendations, skill roadmaps, job discovery, and an intelligent Resume Studio.
keyFeatures: Personalized career and skill recommendations generated via trained ML models
Dynamic career path roadmaps customized to individual assessment outcomes
Integrated 'Resume Studio' supporting multi-resume management and job-tailored optimization
Automated resume analysis and AI-assisted cover-letter synthesis
Unified frontend interface connecting assessment telemetry to backend inference APIs
myContribution: Developed NLP/ML-powered recommendation workflows and integrated model inference with backend APIs to generate personalized career and skill recommendations.
Engineered the core 'Resume Studio' subsystem supporting resume creation, multiple resume management, resume analysis, job-specific tailoring, and cover-letter generation.
Designed clean REST endpoints to connect user assessment inputs to ML inference pipelines.

caseStudy.problem: Students and early-career developers frequently encounter scattered career advice, lack visibility into specific industry skill gaps, and struggle to tailor their resumes effectively for distinct software engineering roles.
caseStudy.objective: Architect a centralized platform that leverages machine learning and natural language processing to evaluate user competency profiles, suggest data-driven career paths, and streamline the resume creation and tailoring workflow.
caseStudy.technicalApproach: Employed a modular architecture combining a Python ML service for text extraction, similarity scoring, and recommendation inference, paired with a Node.js/Express service handling user management, state persistence, and API orchestration.
implementationDetails: Constructed NLP feature extraction pipelines to analyze skill keywords from candidate profiles and job role benchmarks.
Integrated model inference endpoints returning scored career recommendations and personalized curriculum roadmaps.
Built the Resume Studio workspace enabling side-by-side editing, ATS-friendly structuring, and job-description alignment.
Implemented secure RESTful API contracts between the React client and backend services.
contribution: Spearheaded the development of NLP/ML-powered recommendation workflows and integrated model inference with backend APIs.
Designed and implemented Resume Studio with multi-resume management and automated tailoring capabilities.
Refined backend API response structures to ensure responsive client-side state updates.
challengesAndLearnings: Handling diverse phrasing in user inputs and parsing unstructured resume text into standardized skill taxonomies.
Designing intuitive visual feedback while recommendation inference processes run in the background.
Deepened practical understanding of end-to-end ML integration within production web application architectures.

projects.title: AI-Driven Closed-Loop Agricultural Management System
projects.subtitle: Predictive Analytics & Environmental Telemetry Architecture
projects.shortDescription: An automated crop management system utilizing sensor telemetry preprocessing, machine learning predictions, and simulated IoT closed-loop feedback triggers.
keyFeatures: Automated crop decision-support backend powered by predictive machine learning models
Telemetry preprocessing pipelines ingesting simulated environmental and soil sensor data
Yield estimation and crop condition forecasting algorithms
Simulated closed-loop feedback mechanisms triggering automated irrigation and nutrient adjustments
Modular data processing stages separating raw intake from model inference
myContribution: Developed a Python backend to automate crop management decisions using sensor data and machine learning predictions.
Built data pipelines to preprocess and feed agricultural inputs into trained models for yield and condition forecasting.
Implemented IoT-based workflow concepts to simulate real-time data intake and automated response triggers.

caseStudy.problem: Traditional agricultural resource allocation relies heavily on manual observation or post-facto measurement, leading to inefficient irrigation, late disease detection, and sub-optimal harvest yields.
caseStudy.objective: Develop an automated Python decision-support system capable of processing multi-variable sensor inputs and utilizing predictive models to simulate a closed-loop crop advisory workflow.
caseStudy.technicalApproach: Structured a data ingestion and inference pipeline that simulates real-time soil moisture, temperature, and nutrient telemetry, runs these inputs through trained regressors/classifiers, and emits actionable threshold-based recommendations.
implementationDetails: Designed Python preprocessing routines for normalization, outlier handling, and sensor feature validation.
Implemented predictive inference routines forecasting crop condition indexes and expected yields.
Modeled simulated closed-loop actuators that respond autonomously when parameters deviate from target agronomic envelopes.
Encapsulated model scoring into clean modular interfaces suitable for automated batch or streaming execution.
contribution: Engineered the core Python decision engine automating crop advisory outputs.
Designed the data preparation scripts converting multi-dimensional sensor metrics into model-ready tensors.
Formulated the simulated IoT feedback logic that issues programmatic response triggers.
challengesAndLearnings: Calibrating simulated sensor variance to reflect realistic environmental noise and fluctuations.
Maintaining clear separation between conceptual/simulated hardware layers and production-grade software data processing.
Gained hands-on proficiency in building robust data pipelines and integrating predictive models into automated control architectures.
